releaseNotes: Adeloc IPTV v4.1.0 — Full Platform Stability & TV Experience Overhaul This major update resolves critical Android TV remote navigation issues, hardens ExoPlayer playback recovery, enforces strict playlist data isolation, and upgrades the in-app updater for hands-free installation. 📺 Android TV & Remote Navigation * High-Contrast D-Pad Focus Outlines:** Replaced low-visibility grey highlights with vibrant focus borders and elevation scaling across player controls (Play/Pause, Next Episode, Seekbar, Gear icon) and homepage cards. * Revamped Edit Categories Screen:** Fixed TV overscan clipping on bottom action buttons (`Hide Selected`, `Show Selected`, `Done`) and replaced touch-and-hold gestures with direct D-Pad row/checkbox selection. * TV Remote Context Menus:** Mapped remote action keys (`Menu`, `Info`, or long-press `OK`/`Center`) across Live TV, Movies, and Series to manage Favorites and Clear Recents  Video Player & Fullscreen Controls * Eliminated Player Spazzing on TV:** Disabled touch-drag swipe detectors on Android TV devices so D-Pad presses no longer trigger phantom channel swipes or erratic focus jumps. * Strict Channel Drawer Focus Trapping:** Trapped D-Pad focus inside the fullscreen Live TV channel list drawer while open so focus cannot leak to background player controls. * Fullscreen Category Switching & Timer Sync:** Added Left/Right category switcher arrows to the fullscreen channel overlay and synced drawer visibility with the player auto-hide timer. * Unified Settings Gear Menu:** Merged separate audio and playback settings under a single Settings Gear icon (Aspect Ratio, Audio Tracks, Subtitles, Audio Boost, Decoders). * ExoPlayer Series Seeking Crash Fix:** Hardened HTTP timeouts and added automatic player reset on error so stalled series seeks no longer break global playback across Live TV and Movies. 🗄️ Playlist Isolation, Favorites & VOD* Playlist-Scoped State Preservation:** Background syncs now preserve user category edits and keep favorites/recents strictly isolated per playlist ID.* Resolved Live TV Long-Press Conflict:** Separated dedicated favorite toggle icons from long-press context menus so gestures no longer collide.* VOD & Series Resume Dialog:** Fixed resume playback confirmation popups (5%–95% progress threshold) and added a **Cancel** option. 📱 Mobile UX & In-App Updater* Direct Foreground Auto-Installer:** Switched to foreground downloading so the system package installer launches automatically upon download completion without needing to tap notifications.* Mobile Nested Scroll Fix:** Fixed nested touch interception so inner list scrolling no longer drags outer parent containers away.
